tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Page ground under the 24px blueprint grid (grid-line). Small text on it: ink-100, ink-200, ink-muted.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Recessed ground behind sticky bars and wells.

tokens.name: panel-100
tokens.usage: Default panel/card surface. Body text ink-100 / ink-200 on it.

tokens.name: panel-200
tokens.usage: Nested surface inside a panel: stat tiles, Ask box, hover rows, progress-bar track.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg-100, panel-100, panel-200 (≥12.4:1 both themes); primary-button fill with bg-100 text.

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Secondary text, lede, idle nav labels on bg-100, panel-100, panel-200 (≥6.3:1 light, ≥7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Source value, kept exact. FLAG: 3.73:1 on panel-100 and 3.35:1 on bg-100 in light, 4.15:1 on panel-200 dark. Use only for decorative marks, dotted underlines, 1G topology links (≥3.35:1 as a graphic) and text 24px+. Small muted text uses ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Small muted text: eyebrows, step IDs, captions, meta, hop lists, on bg-100, bg-200, panel-100, panel-200 and amber-soft (min 4.53:1 light, 4.97:1 dark).

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline: panel borders, table rows, dashed dividers.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: control borders, chip outline, checkbox idle, dashed dividers in the gate track.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Signature accent for marks, not small text: active stage border, packet, 10G links, glows, the // in the wordmark, large figures 24px+. Source value kept exact. FLAG: 3.54:1 on panel-100 light; small amber text uses amber-strong.

tokens.name: amber-strong
tokens.usage: Amber text below 24px (chips, live status, gate labels, palette match marks) and amber fills that carry text (Button amber, active hop bullets) with on-fill. Text on bg-100, bg-200, panel-100, panel-200, amber-soft (min 4.65:1 light, 7.18:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every control. Alias of amber-strong: ≥4.6:1 on every light ground, ≥7:1 dark. On code surfaces use code-warn.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Amber tint: gate callouts, selected trace row, amber chips. Text on it: ink-100 or amber-strong.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on filled signal colours: amber-strong, green, red, teal, violet (≥5.1:1 light with white, ≥6.6:1 dark with near-black). Never white on amber.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Links, verify marks and 2.5G links on panel-100 and panel-200 (4.9:1 / 4.53:1 light, ≥8.2:1 dark). Source value kept exact. FLAG: 4.41:1 on bg-100 and 4.17:1 on teal-soft in light; small teal text uses teal-strong.

tokens.name: teal-strong
tokens.usage: Teal text on teal-soft and other tints (chips, adapt callout labels, flashcard answers) on teal-soft, bg-100, panel-100, panel-200 (min 5.04:1 light, 7.40:1 dark).

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Teal tint: adapt callouts, teal chips. Text on it: ink-100 or teal-strong.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Danger: destructive risk, blocked hops, LIVE dot, lab-only links. Text on bg-100, panel-100, panel-200 and red-soft (≥4.78:1 light, ≥5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Warn callout ground, red chips. Text on it: ink-100 or red.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Done: checkbox fill (on-fill tick), completed bars, progress ring, power links. Source value kept exact. FLAG: 4.1:1 on green-soft light; text on green-soft uses green-strong.

tokens.name: green-strong
tokens.usage: Green text: safe chips, done status, completion banner, on green-soft, bg-100, panel-100, panel-200 (min 4.93:1 light, 7.37:1 dark).

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Completion banner ground, green chips. Text on it: ink-100 or green-strong.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Unconfirmed/proposal labels and Tailscale links. Text on bg-100, panel-100, panel-200 and violet-soft (≥4.79:1 light, ≥6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Unverified callout ground, violet chips. Text on it: ink-100 or violet.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of terminals, consoles, code blocks and the swarm feed; dark in both themes. Text on it: code-ink, code-out, code-muted and the code signal colours.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Commands and primary text on code-bg (13.5:1 / 15.7:1) and code-bar.

tokens.name: code-out
tokens.usage: Command output on code-bg (8.3:1 / 9.6:1).

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, idle stage pips, title-bar text on code-bg and code-bar (≥5.6:1).

tokens.name: code-bar
tokens.usage: Title bar and header strip of terminals and consoles.

tokens.name: code-line
tokens.usage: Borders and button outlines on code surfaces.

tokens.name: code-btn
tokens.usage: Small buttons on code surfaces (replay, copy); text code-ink.

tokens.name: code-accent
tokens.usage: Prompt and agent names on code-bg (8.9:1).

tokens.name: code-ok
tokens.usage: Passed lines and pips on code-bg (8.7:1).

tokens.name: code-ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of PASSED verdicts and passed pips; text code-ok (7.4:1).

tokens.name: code-warn
tokens.usage: Running line, live cursor and the focus ring on code surfaces (8.6:1).

tokens.name: code-err
tokens.usage: Failed lines and the console LIVE dot on code-bg (6.0:1).

tokens.name: code-err-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of BLOCKED verdicts; text code-err (5.7:1).
